_note: The full relational grammar between the six positions. Three families (named by register, NOT by 'family A/B/C', which collides with the lens-squares) × three pairs, doubled by the Day/Night cover = nine squares, EIGHT distinct (the (2,3) hinge coincides). The three lens-squares of coordinate-system.json are the Becoming/mirror family alone — one family of three. A convergence reading organised only by the complementary-pair squares sees Becoming and misses Being and Knowing.

families.gloss: the natural dyads — neighbours co-constituting, neither able to be what it is without the other; adjacency as co-constitution
the mirror-pairs summing to 5 — a position and its converse answering one another across the field's centre; the mirror is how the field moves
families.note: these three pairs are the three lens-squares [0+5], [1+4], [2+3] — the complementary-pair slice the skills enter as basins (Square A, Square B, Square C)

families.gloss: the crossings — each leaving one constituted dyad and crossing a knowing-limit into the next; (5,0) is the §5→§0' return itself, the whole crossing back into the ground it cannot know as content

squares.doubling: each square is a Day-pair doubled by its conjugate Night inversion (the D↔ operator). D voices the Night (pratibimba) face of the pair; it is NOT a fourth family.

coincidence.reason: (2,3) is the only pair both adjacent (→ Being) and summing to 5 (→ Becoming/mirror) — the hexad midpoint where adjacency coincides with complementarity. L2/L3 (Word/Logos, Operation/Pattern) is Being and Becoming at once: logic and process, one structure seen from two faces. The coincidence is basis-invariant.

held_envelope.square: lens-square [0+5] (L0, L0', L5, L5') = the Converse-Mirror (Becoming) tetrad on the two implicate poles P0/P5
held_envelope.role: held as the reading's #0/#5 envelope — the poles frame the explicate four (positions 1–4), they do not participate as differentiated content
held_envelope.correction: NOT 'ground and quintessence' — that names the endpoint positions' semantic duals, not their relation (Converse-Mirror). Held for its pole-position, and it is one of three mirror-squares (the other two, [1+4] and [2+3], are inside the fanned work).

reading_constraint: A convergence reading (e.g. /mef-refract) must declare which REGISTER each convergence holds under (Being / Becoming / Knowing-Unknowing; both at the #2/#3 hinge). Register (which relation) is orthogonal to STRENGTH (homology = same operation in different materials; analogy = mere resemblance). Reading by the mirror squares alone misses two-thirds of the grammar.
